findings.evidence: grep `indResHomEquiv` in TauCeti: only uses and `simp [indResAdjunction, indResHomEquiv]` unfoldings (FiniteIndex.lean:73,136; Shapiro.lean:91); no apply lemma exists.
findings.fix: Add `Rep.indResHomEquiv_hom_apply` (value on `IndV.mk _ _ 1 a`) and an `indCoindIso` `.hom.hom` evaluation lemma, then rewrite with them instead of using `change`.
findings.issue: `indHomMackeyLinearEquiv_indMap_apply` uses three large `change` blocks to unfold `indResHomEquiv`, `Rep.ofHom` and the intertwining-map coercion of `indCoindIso` by definition; this is brittle.

findings.evidence: TauCeti/CategoryTheory/Linear/FullyFaithful.lean:37 has only `Functor.homLinearEquiv_apply`; there is no lemma for the inverse.
findings.fix: Add a lemma that `F.map ((F.homLinearEquiv R X Y).symm g) = g` (or that the inverse equals `F.preimage g`) next to `Functor.homLinearEquiv_apply`, and derive the apply lemma from it directly.
findings.issue: `mackeyHomSelfLinearEquiv_apply` applies `apply_symm_apply` to rebuild the inverse of the full-functor equivalence, then uses `change … at h'` to undo the carrier wrappers.

findings.fix: Add `FDRep.forget₂HomLinearEquiv_apply` and `_symm_apply` lemmas and replace the `erw` and the `change` with `rw`/`simp`.
findings.issue: The `erw [LinearEquiv.trans_apply, …, symm_apply_apply]` in `indHomMackeyIdentityComponent_forget` and the `change` at line 243 (inverse equivalence to `(forget₂ …).map`) depend on two category instances unfolding to the same thing.

findings.evidence: Lines 49-52: `change B.ρ ⟨s, hs⟩ ∘ₗ B.ρ (mackeyToH s H H y) = …` followed by a second `change` to `*`.
findings.fix: Rewrite with a `Rep.res` ρ-apply simp lemma (add one if missing) instead of the double `change`.
findings.issue: `mackeySelfTwistIso` uses two consecutive `change` steps to restate the goal through `Rep.res` as composition of `B.ρ` values, relying on unfolding the restriction by definition.

findings.fix: Factor it into one lemma, e.g. `DoubleCoset.out_mk_one_mem : (DoubleCoset.mk H H 1).out ∈ H`, in GroupTheory/DoubleCoset.
findings.issue: The membership proof `(doubleCosetMk_eq_mk_one_iff_mem H _).mp (DoubleCoset.out_eq' (DoubleCoset.mk H H 1))` is written out four times (lines 149, 162, 204, 217).

summary: The proofs build, but several rely on `change`/`erw` to unfold adjunction, restriction and forgetful-equivalence wrappers by definition, where explicit evaluation lemmas are missing. A membership proof is also written out four times.
